options.text: 1, because return in try wins.
None, because returns cancel out.
Error, because two returns are illegal.

questions.subject: PYTHON
questions.learningObjective: Explain finally guarantee with return
questions.stem: In a multi-step planning problem, explain why finally runs even when the try block returns early.

answer.exemplar: The finally block is guaranteed to execute before the function returns, even if the try block uses return, because cleanup must happen.

questions.explanation: finally runs before the function actually returns, ensuring cleanup. The tempting wrong idea assumes return skips finally.

questions.learningObjective: Explain why iterating a file is memory efficient
questions.stem: In a multi-step planning problem, explain why iterating a file line by line is memory efficient.

questions.explanation: Line iteration streams the file, keeping memory low. The tempting wrong idea loads the whole file.
